note: P4390 (Pro 31:13) — she seeks wool and flax, and works with willing hands.

dims.v: enterprise — she seeks out wool and flax to work
the seeking-out of wool and flax to work — the diligent industry and enterprise that goes looking for materials and labour, an active, resourceful diligence rather than idle waiting
the willing eagerness it works with (267352)
welded to the glad willingness of her labour

darash (seek/seek out) — 'she SEEKS wool and flax, and works with willing hands' (31:13); her diligence is enterprising, actively seeking out work. Industry that goes and finds, not idleness that waits, marks the capable woman (cf 31:27).
glad labour — working with eager delight, not grudging toil
the working with willing/delighting hands — the glad, eager spirit in which she labours, delight rather than drudgery, industry animated by good-will and pleasure in the work
welded to the enterprising industry it gladdens

chephets (delight/willingness) — 'and works with WILLING hands' (31:13); her labour is glad, not grudging — she works with delight. The willing spirit turns toil into a pleasure and marks the difference between drudgery and industry.
